title: Bros. Attacks Combo System
description: Cooperative Bros Attacks discovered in play, not bought. A pair logs two failed attempts with stated reasons, then the third attempt lands and the players name the technique themselves. Badges recognise teamwork; shop kits are gear that makes an attempt safer or free for a technique, never a way to purchase one. Easy/Medium/Hard drill difficulty changes cost, timing and payoff; GMs can set item quantities and hide items from players.
